body:
Separate draft queue alongside random. core/draft (16 picks, 10x1/5x2/1x3 buckets), dw_match_init_decks, DRAFT_PICK/OFFER/DONE frames + QUEUE same_deck, per-mode pairing, decks.ndjson + replayable draft matches.ndjson, bots keep deck on win/draw and redraft on loss (dw_bot --mode draft, bot_pool --mode, dw-draft-bot@ unit), Windows GUI mode toggle/draft screen/same-deck-redraft, Android protocol+Session+DraftModel+draft UI. Verified: unit (draft invariants), e2e (separate queues, 1.7k drafts, replay), GUI draft selftest, Android core+integration tests, Bazel APK builds. NOT deployed live; Android UI never run on a device.

⚓ ☃
title: DEADWEIGHT draft mode: own queue, 16-pick 23-card draft, deck log (b709f44 + follow-ups)
